films.title: The Coalition The Movie The Trilogy
films.description: Space Mob's third Coalition feature is an all-winch street-wakeboarding film built over nearly three years. The 2021 Wake Awards Film/Video of the Year follows eight riders through urban spots and waterways around the world, with substantial filming in Ontario, and the official uninterrupted cut runs 50 minutes, 25 seconds.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable uninterrupted complete film on Space Mob's official YouTube channel. Current player metadata reports playable status, embedding support, the November 1, 2021 publication date, official publisher, exact 3,025-second runtime, artwork, and the eight full-part rider credits.

Space Mob's first-party video catalog embeds the uninterrupted TCTMTT film, identifies it as the third Coalition feature, says the crew filmed it for about three years, and supplies the same eight full-part rider credits.

Independent interview with Space Mob leader and editor Wesley Mark Jacobsen establishes the all-winch street-film concept, nearly three-year production, eight-rider lineup, and his behind-the-lens and editing role without assigning an unsupported formal director credit.
Independent awards coverage names The Coalition The Movie The Trilogy, produced by Space Mob, as the 2021 Wake Awards Best Film/Video of the Year.

The provincial sport organization's 2022 report calls it the prior year's world number-one wake film, identifies Ontario riders Dary Znebel, Jesse Jarrett, and Coti Scaglia, and states that much of their footage was filmed in Ontario.
